# [In preview] Public Preview: Auto scaling of ingestion limits in Azure Monitor workspace

## What Changed

Auto scaling introduces a per-workspace capability in Azure Monitor Workspace (AMW) to automatically scale ingestion limits based on observed usage patterns. When enabled, the system dynamically adjusts ingestion limits (quota ceiling) to maintain healthy
